Can I use Lovart posters for Facebook Ads?
Yes! All assets generated by Lovart on paid plans come with a commercial license, making them safe for Facebook Ads, Instagram promotions, and other marketing channels.
What sizes can I generate?
Lovart supports all standard aspect ratios including 1:1 (Square), 4:5 (Portrait), 16:9 (Landscape), and 9:16 (Stories). You can easily resize designs using our Smart Resize feature.
Can I edit the text on the poster?
Absolutely. Lovart's exclusive 'Text Edit' feature allows you to click on any text in the generated image and rewrite it, change the font style, or fix typos without regenerating the whole image.
Does Lovart support my brand logo?
Yes. You can upload your logo and ask the Agent to place it on the poster. You can also define your brand colors to ensure consistency across all your designs.
How is this different from Canva?
Canva relies on templates that thousands of people use. Lovart uses AI to generate unique, custom designs from scratch based on your specific needs, ensuring your brand stands out.
